Web check of 2026-07-27, in the country's own language, revisited the same day after the ownership ruling. The value stays at 1 and the dispute is lifted, but not the source caveat, and the two must not be confused. What was disputed was a method question: the denominator required a course backed by a state institution, and since 1 September 2020 the University of Theatre and Film Arts in Budapest is no longer a public institution but is run by a private foundation, a transfer that prompted a prolonged conflict over academic autonomy. That question is now answered for the whole series: ownership is not a criterion, a state-recognised award is. The university remains Hungary's national theatre and film school and its qualifications remain state-recognised, so it counts, and the status returns to open. Confidence stays at estimated, for a reason that has nothing to do with the ruling. The institution's own site refuses automated reading and did so again today on two further routes, szfe.hu and felveteli.szfe.hu, both 403; the state admissions portal felvi.hu answered 503. Every route to a first-party or state reading has now failed twice, in two separate passes. The recorded source stays an encyclopaedic entry, which establishes the puppet actor specialism from 1995 and the puppet director specialism from 2008-09 but is not the institution and is not the State. Upgrading to sourced would mean calling an encyclopaedia a state register. To be closed by a route that is neither: the Oktatási Hivatal register of accredited programmes, or direct contact with the university.

establishments.name: Színház- és Filmművészeti Egyetem (SZFE)
establishments.award: Puppet actor specialism since 1995, puppet director specialism since 2008-09
establishments.description: Hungary's national theatre and film university, teaching puppetry for thirty years. Transferred from state ownership to a private foundation in September 2020, which blocked the count until the ruling of 2026-07-27 made the recognition of the award, not the ownership of the institution, the test. It counts. What is still missing is a first-party source: the university's site refuses automated reading.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90.
